GREET(1)     User Commands      GREET(1)

NAME                                    

greet - print a friendly greeting       

SYNOPSIS                                

greet [-n count] [--shout] name...      

DESCRIPTION                             

greet writes a greeting for each name to
standard output. The greeting is “Hello”
unless --shout says otherwise — then it 
is louder.                              

Options                                 

-n, --count=N
    Repeat each greeting N times.       

-s, --shout
    Write the greeting in capitals.     
                                        
         • Works with every name.       
         • Ignores the locale.          

EXAMPLES                                

                                        
 $ greet -n 2 world                     
 Hello, world                           
 Hello, world                           
                                        

FILES                                   

                               
 Path          Purpose         
 ───────────────────────────── 
 ~/.greetrc    User settings   
 /etc/greetrc  System settings 
                               

SEE ALSO                                

echo(1), printf(1). Project page:       
https://example.com/greet.              

greet 1.0     October 2026      GREET(1)
